results.name: Each role sees only its relevant primary navigation; desktop has at most four choices
Worker account menu has eight useful actions, with no repeated bookings or marketing links
Every registered page and dynamic route dispatches to an existing page
Menu keyboard open, tab boundary, Escape and close return focus correctly
Bookings API failures show an escaped explanation and retry instead of silently returning
All literal internal navigation destinations resolve and required local assets exist
Legacy document, profile, funding and notification links go to canonical Settings
Next actions has no duplicated details, documents, funding or notification editors
Late Next actions fetch cannot redirect after leaving the page
Every Settings/admin navigation resets viewport; pending callbacks cannot scroll another page
